name: Maintenance and incident follow-up
purpose: Respond to an incident, preserve evidence, and turn follow-up actions into owned work.
trigger: An incident, defect, dependency alert, or maintenance task is reported.
prerequisites: A reporter or observed symptom is recorded.

steps.action: Reduce ongoing harm using the smallest reversible action.
Separate observed facts from hypotheses; preserve relevant sanitized evidence.
Restore service using the approved recovery path and verify the result.
Record root-cause confidence, owners, and dated follow-up actions.

recovery: Escalate if customer data or security may be affected.
Never include credentials or personal data in incident notes.
